new_today_news.headline: Ingredients, Flavors & Fragrances Stocks Q1 In Review: Darling Ingredients (NYSE:DAR) Vs Peers
new_today_news.summary: Analyst review of Darling Ingredients' Q1 2026 performance relative to peers in the ingredients, flavors & fragrances sector. new_today_news.headline: WRM Vacuum Truck Driver Recruiting - Las Vegas
new_today_news.summary: Waste Resource Management (WRM) is actively recruiting CDL vacuum truck drivers in Las Vegas at $54,600 annually with weekly pay, comprehensive benefits, and emphasis on work-life balance. The job listing highlights local vacuum truck operations, liquid waste transport to treatment facilities, and company-provided training programs with career growth opportunities.

new_today_news.summary: The 2026 New York Restaurant Show at Jacob K. Javits Convention Center featured hundreds of exhibitors showcasing foodservice technology, kitchen equipment, and hospitality services to restaurant owners and foodservice professionals. The event served as a platform for networking and discovering industry trends.

new_today_news.headline: National Restaurant Association Quarterly Consumer Insights Survey Q2 2026
new_today_news.summary: Latest NRA consumer survey shows 36% of consumers report spending less at restaurants than last quarter, with younger consumers leading the decline. Value-driven behavior is increasing as consumers trade down and seek affordability.

new_today_news.headline: Capturing Landfill Gas Earlier: Takeaways from the New SWANA Horizontal Gas Collectors Report
new_today_news.summary: SWANA's Applied Research Foundation released a new report on horizontal landfill gas collection systems, addressing design, installation, and operational guidance. The report includes real-world case studies and emphasizes site-specific planning and maintenance considerations for effective interim and early-stage gas collection.

recent_news.summary: Weekly pipeline report tracking multi-unit brand openings across the U.S., including Potbelly Sandwich Works in Dallas, Nekter Juice Bar in Tennessee, North Italia in California, and several others. Reports over 130 new American restaurant openings per week.

recent_news.headline: Squamish completes $12.8M wastewater treatment plant upgrade
recent_news.summary: Squamish completed a $12.8 million wastewater treatment plant upgrade that included construction of a new secondary clarifier, concentric ring bioreactor, and septage receiving station. The improvements are designed to increase treatment capacity and reduce carbon emissions.

recent_news.headline: May 2026 Restaurant Openings & Closings
recent_news.summary: May 2026 saw more than 20 new Phoenix-area restaurant openings and six closures including Serrano's Mexican Restaurants' McKellips Road location after 34 years due to rising operating costs. Frank & Lupe's reopened under new ownership.
